sections.skill: Prove that alternate interior angles are congruent

questions.skill: Prove that alternate interior angles are congruent
questions.standard_level: High school (Common Core high-school standard; this bank places it at Grade 9 as a first forward step. This is an instructional choice, not an official grade assignment.)
questions.response: write the answer and show the required work
questions.prompt: In the figure, lines m and n are parallel. Prove that angle 1 = angle 8. Give a reason for each step.
questions.prompt_markup: In the figure, lines m and n are parallel. Prove that angle 1 = angle 8. Give a reason for each step.
questions.required_method: A valid chain of reasons. Other valid orders are accepted. A conclusion without reasons is not full credit. Example: angle 1 = angle 5 (corresponding angles, m ∥ n); angle 5 = angle 8 (vertical angles); so angle 1 = angle 8.
